title: Open purchase orders
description: Open purchase orders (not yet fully released) with supplier, company code, purchasing organization and processing status.
select: PurchaseOrder, PurchaseOrderType, Supplier, CompanyCode, PurchasingOrganization, PurchasingGroup, PurchaseOrderDate, PurchasingProcessingStatus, ReleaseIsNotCompleted, DocumentCurrency

title: Open purchase orders by supplier
description: Same open-PO recipe; ordered by supplier then date (thin variant — inherits views/select/where).

title: Material stock by plant

select: Material, Plant, StorageLocation, Batch, InventoryStockType, InventorySpecialStockType, MatlWrhsStkQtyInMatlBaseUnit, SpecialStockIdfgStockOwner

title: Product master by type

title: Purchase order items (API)

title: Sales order items
description: Sales order item list with product, quantity and net amount dimensions.

title: Billing documents
description: Billing document headers for SD billing status and customer overview.

title: Outbound deliveries
description: Delivery document headers for logistics execution tracking.
select: DeliveryDocument, SDDocumentCategory, DeliveryDocumentType, CreatedByUser, CreationDate, CreationTime, LastChangedByUser, LastChangeDate

title: Business partner master

title: Customer master
description: Customer master overview for account and sales-area related reporting.
select: Customer, CustomerName, CustomerFullName, BPCustomerName, BPCustomerFullName, CreatedByUser, CreationDate, AddressID

title: Supplier master
description: Supplier master overview for procurement partner reporting.

select: SourceLedger, CompanyCode, FiscalYear, AccountingDocument, LedgerGLLineItem, Ledger, LedgerFiscalYear, GLRecordType

title: Purchase order lines with supplier
description: PO header joined to item lines and supplier master — scrubbed join recipe from public SCM SQL templates + ABAP Cloud SQL guidance (I_PurchaseOrder* mapped to API01 views present in this KB).
select: t1.PurchaseOrder, t1.PurchaseOrderType, t1.PurchaseOrderDate, t1.CompanyCode, t1.Supplier, t3.SupplierName, t2.PurchaseOrderItem, t2.Material, t2.Plant

title: Sales order items with customer
description: Sales order header joined to items and sold-to customer — public SCM SQL join pattern, field names checked against KB view-fields.
select: t1.SalesOrder, t1.SalesOrderType, t1.CreationDate, t1.SoldToParty, t3.CustomerName, t2.SalesOrderItem, t2.Material, t2.Plant, t2.RequestedDeliveryDate

title: Billing document items with customer
description: Billing header joined to items and sold-to customer — public SCM SQL join pattern adapted to KB field names.
select: t1.BillingDocument, t1.BillingDocumentType, t1.CreationDate, t1.SoldToParty, t3.CustomerName, t2.BillingDocumentItem, t2.Material, t2.Plant

title: Outbound delivery items with customer
description: Outbound delivery header joined to items and sold-to customer — public SCM SQL join pattern; uses I_OutboundDelivery* (KB also has I_DeliveryDocument).
select: t1.OutboundDelivery, t1.DeliveryDocumentType, t1.CreationDate, t1.SoldToParty, t3.CustomerName, t2.OutboundDeliveryItem, t2.Material, t2.Plant

title: Material document header with items
description: Material document header joined to item lines (composite key year+document). Mapped from public SCM SQL that used I_MaterialDocumentHeader/Item → KB *_2 views. Optional GR filter left as comment-free structural example without live tenant literals.

title: Journal entry headers
description: FI journal entry headers from released CDS (ABAP Cloud guidance: I_JournalEntry instead of BKPF). Complements existing library journal-entry-items recipe.
